title: Auto hide not being shown in dock autohide not working
summary: The screenshot from PowerToys 0.100.2 shows the Command Palette Dock settings before the Auto-hide control shipped; the current stable line contains the feature, and the existing automated comment has already asked the reporter to update and confirm.

judgment.rationale: The screenshot clearly shows version-era Dock settings with Always on top but no Auto-hide toggle. Public history shows merged PR #48565 added a separate Auto-hide setting after the v0.100.2 release branch and the first containing release tags are in the v0.101 line. The current source exposes the Auto-hide toggle and handles taskbar-edge conflicts. The issue already has a public request to update to v0.101.2362.0, provide concrete steps, and confirm whether it still reproduces, so no duplicate action should be emitted.
evidence: The reporter is using PowerToys 0.100.2 and attached a screenshot of the Dock settings page without an Auto-hide control.
The screenshot shows Always on top set to Off; that setting controls z-order and is separate from Auto-hide.
Merged PR #48565 added the Dock Auto-hide setting, UI, app-bar behavior, conflict handling, and tests.
The v0.100.2 tag's DockSettingsPage.xaml contains Always on top but no Auto-hide control.
Current source and v0.101 release tags contain CmdPal_DockSettingsPage_AutoHide.
The automated triage comment already asks the reporter to update to v0.101.2362.0, provide concrete steps, and confirm the result.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter to test a v0.101 stable build and clarify the remaining behavior if Auto-hide is present but ineffective.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged PR #48565 implemented the missing Dock Auto-hide feature, and it is present in the v0.101 stable line that the existing triage comment asks the reporter to test.

issue_context.summary: The reported missing control matches an older release that predates the shipped Dock Auto-hide UI, while any claim that Auto-hide still fails on a current build remains unverified.
known_information: PowerToys 0.100.2 was installed from Microsoft Store.
The issue is labeled Product-Command Palette and includes a Dock settings screenshot.
The screenshot shows no Auto-hide row and shows Always on top set to Off.
Merged PR #48565 added Auto-hide as a distinct Dock behavior setting.
Current source binds CmdPal_DockSettingsPage_AutoHide to SettingsViewModel.Dock_AutoHide.
The issue currently has Needs-Author-Feedback and no author reply after the automated request.
inferences: The absent toggle is explained by the installed release rather than a failed rendering path.

If the feature remains ineffective after updating, taskbar auto-hide on the same screen edge or another app-bar registration conflict would be a relevant discriminator because current code falls back to pinned mode in that case.
issue_context.analysis: Version and history evidence explain the screenshot. The only unresolved question is whether a current build still fails after the reporter enables the now-present control, and that exact confirmation has already been requested upstream.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue body, screenshot, automated comment, labels, assignees, and timeline.
Compared v0.100.2 DockSettingsPage.xaml with current source and traced merged PR #48565.
Confirmed current DockWindow.xaml.cs implements Auto-hide and explicitly falls back to pinned mode when the Windows taskbar owns auto-hide on the same edge.
Searched open upstream issues for Dock auto-hide and found no separate current regression that supersedes this version-specific explanation.

information_gaps.information: Whether the Auto-hide control appears after updating to PowerToys v0.101.2362.0 or newer.
information_gaps.why_needed: This confirms whether the report is fully explained by the older release.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Update PowerToys, reopen Command Palette Dock settings, and report the displayed PowerToys version and whether the Auto-hide row is present.

information_gaps.information: If Auto-hide is present but still ineffective, the exact Dock edge, Windows taskbar edge and auto-hide state, and numbered actions used.
information_gaps.why_needed: Current code intentionally falls back to pinned mode when another auto-hide app bar, especially the taskbar, owns the same edge.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After updating, list the Dock position, taskbar position and auto-hide state, enable Dock Auto-hide, move the pointer away, and describe what remains visible.
